text: This is Live Translate, running locally in test mode, with an offline test dictionary standing in for the translator.

caption: 1 · Pick a direction
text: On the host computer, pick a direction. We'll go both ways, English and Chinese.

caption: 2 · Share the code
text: The room gets a six character code, and a QR code for the other person.

caption: 3 · Join on the phone
text: On their phone, they type the code. No app, and no account.

caption: 4 · Speak, they read
text: A recording can't use the microphone, so a test hook feeds in the same results speech recognition would. Words show up as you talk, and the Chinese lands on the phone a moment later.

caption: 5 · Chinese back to English
text: When your friend answers in Chinese, switch the language, and you read it in English.

caption: 6 · Reply from the phone
text: You say thanks, and they can type a reply right on the phone.

caption: 7 · Bigger text
text: Bigger text is one tap away.

caption: 8 · Bilingual transcript
text: Every final line is saved with its translation and a time stamp. Download it as Markdown, text, or JSON.
Live Translate. Speak here, and they read it there.
